description: The fleet's default arming policy. Each organisation's agent-fabric-settings repository (projects/registry.json settings_repos) holds repos/<repo>.json, which overrides this per repository: objects merge recursively, scalars replace. The shape is identities/schemas/arming.schema.json. Below the minimum of work commits a PR is armed only on the owner's word; the 8 and 16 are the minimum and the size above which the gate advises splitting.
